title: orobanche gracilis var. ulicis
intro: Orobanche gracilis var. ulicis, commonly known as Gypsy broomrape, is a parasitic plant species that belongs to the family Orobanchaceae. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Gypsy broomrape include its ability to lower blood pressure and reduce stress, making it a popular natural remedy in folk medicine. The bioactive constituents of Orobanche gracilis var. ulicis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
